hunks.baseline: If you ever witnessed an airplane with both wings engulfed in flames hurtling toward the ground, you would be seized by a terror that transcended species.
hunks.sol: Seeing an airplane hurtling toward the ground with both wings engulfed in flames inspired a terror that transcended species.

hunks.baseline: The ogres reputed to be so fearsome screamed. The trolls screamed, too.
hunks.sol: The fearsome ogres screamed. So did the trolls.

hunks.baseline: The monsters that could scream were the lucky ones.
hunks.sol: The monsters capable of screaming were the lucky ones.

hunks.baseline: Most of them—including Shao Shen—could only stare at the airplane charging toward the ground, frozen like statues.
hunks.sol: Most of them—including Shao Shen—could only stare at the airplane plunging toward the ground, frozen like statues.

hunks.baseline: But his feet and hands would not move.
hunks.sol: Neither his hands nor his feet would move.

hunks.baseline: More importantly, Shao Shen and the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces had been surrounded in the middle of the battlefield. They had not even been given a chance to escape.
hunks.sol: More importantly, Shao Shen and the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces were surrounded in the middle of the battlefield. They had no chance to escape.

hunks.baseline: The same thought appeared in everyone’s mind at that very moment.
hunks.sol: The same thought flashed through everyone’s mind.

hunks.baseline: Along with an earsplitting roar, the airplane’s enormous fuselage swept across the battlefield.
hunks.sol: With an earsplitting roar, the airplane’s enormous fuselage swept across the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: That earth-shaking collision began at the very rear of the monster army, which was scattering like a swarm of ants.
hunks.sol: The earth-shaking collision began at the rear of the monster army as it scattered like a swarm of ants.

hunks.baseline: The massive steel object, weighing dozens of tons, smashed and burst through everything in its path.
hunks.sol: The massive steel behemoth, weighing dozens of tons, smashed and burst through everything in its path.

hunks.baseline: The monsters’ green blood spurted like fountains, and limbs of every size flew in all directions.
hunks.sol: Green blood spurted from the monsters like fountains, and limbs of every size flew in all directions.

hunks.baseline: No matter how powerful a monster’s physical defenses were, there was a limit. Nothing could stop the airplane now transformed into a monster blender.
hunks.sol: No matter how formidable a monster’s physical defenses were, they had their limits. Nothing could stop the airplane now that it had become a giant monster blender.

hunks.baseline: The eerie sounds of flesh being torn apart swallowed the monsters’ screams. It was a scene of carnage such as Shao Shen had never seen or heard before.
hunks.sol: The gruesome sounds of flesh being torn apart swallowed the monsters’ screams. It was a hellish scene unlike anything Shao Shen had ever seen or heard.

hunks.baseline: The Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces heard their native language loud and clear despite everything happening around them. The word *reinforcements* flashed through their minds, and Shao Shen was stunned.
hunks.sol: Despite the chaos, the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces heard their native language loud and clear. The word *reinforcements* flashed through their minds, and Shao Shen was stunned.

hunks.baseline: The powerful mana carried in that voice. It had to be an S-rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: The voice carried immense mana. It had to belong to an S-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: *To think they’d use a method those island bastards employed back in World War II. Had they not considered that their own allies might die too?*
hunks.sol: *To think he’d resort to a tactic those island bastards used during World War II. Did he not consider that he might kill his own allies too?*

hunks.baseline: *He looks like someone dispatched by the Central Military Commission… But did our country even have an S-rank Hunter like that?*
hunks.sol: *He must have been dispatched by the Central Military Commission… But did our country even have an S-rank Hunter like that?*

hunks.baseline: The massive steel object that had ground its way through half the battlefield was charging straight toward him and the Hunters.
hunks.sol: The massive steel behemoth that had ground its way across half the battlefield was charging straight toward him and the other Hunters.

hunks.baseline: When it came to struggling for survival, there was no distinction between friend and foe.
hunks.sol: When it came to the struggle for survival, there was no distinction between friend and foe.

hunks.baseline: Forgetting that there was a human right in front of him, Shao Shen thrust his dagger at the monster crashing into him.
hunks.sol: Forgetting that there was a human right in front of it, a monster slammed into Shao Shen in its panic to escape. He thrust his dagger into it.

hunks.baseline: Thud!
hunks.sol: Shunk!

hunks.baseline: The dead monster’s body collapsed toward Shao Shen.
hunks.sol: The dead monster’s body collapsed on top of him.

hunks.baseline: Monsters were surging in from every direction, leaving him unable to move even one step. Feeling the immense weight bearing down on him, Shao Shen shouted.
hunks.sol: Monsters surged in from every direction, leaving him unable to move even a single step. Feeling the immense weight bearing down on him, Shao Shen shouted.

hunks.baseline: He was right. The battle was not over yet. A Hunter was someone who had to kill monsters until the last moment before his own breath ran out.
hunks.sol: He was right. The battle was not over yet. A Hunter had to keep killing monsters until the final moment, when his own breath ran out.

hunks.baseline: *This is enough.*
hunks.sol: *Good. That’ll do.*

hunks.baseline: The enormous airplane was already less than twenty meters away.
hunks.sol: The airplane’s enormous fuselage was already less than twenty meters away.

hunks.baseline: Its speed had decreased considerably since the beginning, but with everyone trapped in place, evading it seemed impossible.
hunks.sol: Its speed had fallen considerably, but with everyone trapped in place, avoiding it seemed impossible.

hunks.baseline: Krrrrrunch! Ssssh!
hunks.sol: Krrrrrunch! Splaash!

hunks.baseline: Covered in a sticky liquid that he assumed was blood, Shao Shen thought:
hunks.sol: Drenched in a sticky liquid that he assumed was blood, Shao Shen thought:

hunks.baseline: *Wouldn’t it normally be “Aagh”?*
hunks.sol: *Shouldn’t it normally be “Aagh”?*

hunks.baseline: The strange sound was hardly an appropriate death cry. Shao Shen cautiously lifted his eyelids.
hunks.sol: It was a strange sound for someone’s death cry. Shao Shen cautiously opened his eyes.

hunks.baseline: The airplane had stopped a few steps away, and two men were chatting beside it.
hunks.sol: The airplane had stopped a few steps away, and two men stood beside it, chatting casually.

hunks.baseline: “Then carry them out, Team Leader Choi. Oh, right. Is that bastard who called us Bangzi[^2] earlier alive, too?”
hunks.sol: “Then carry them out, Team Leader Choi. Oh, right. Is that bastard who called us *bangzi*[^1] earlier still alive?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. He’s, uh, alive, at least.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. He’s, uh… alive, at least.”

hunks.baseline: Who, when, where, what, how, and why. Even the five Ws and one H could not organize a scene this bizarre.
hunks.sol: Who, when, where, what, why, and how. Even the five Ws and one H were not enough to explain a scene this bizarre.

hunks.baseline: *How did the airplane suddenly stop, and who are those people? Were they not Hunters sent by the Central Military Commission?*
hunks.sol: *How did the airplane stop so suddenly, and who are those people? Aren’t they Hunters sent by the Central Military Commission?*

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen could not understand the words of the refined-looking man who resembled a young master, but he knew what country the language belonged to.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen could not understand the refined-looking man who resembled a young master, but he recognized the language.

hunks.baseline: Their longtime neighbor.
hunks.sol: It belonged to their longtime neighbor.

hunks.baseline: *Wait. If he’s Korean…!*
hunks.sol: *Wait. If they’re Korean…!*

hunks.baseline: A muscular young man a full head taller than everyone else.
hunks.sol: A muscular young man who stood a full head taller than everyone else.

hunks.baseline: The man he had only seen on television—his idol—was standing right in front of him.
hunks.sol: The man he had only ever seen on television—his idol—was standing right in front of him.

hunks.baseline: “Then… Sibeol-jwa…”
hunks.sol: “Then… Sibeol-jwa…”[^2]

hunks.baseline: A wave of relief and hope ran through Shao Shen’s entire body, making him tremble.
hunks.sol: Relief and hope swept through Shao Shen, making his entire body tremble.
[^1]: *Bangzi* (棒子) is a derogatory Chinese slur for Koreans.

hunks.baseline: [^1]: *Sibeol* is a Korean profanity, while *-jwa* is a playful suffix used in a nickname.
hunks.sol: [^2]: *Sibeol* is a Korean profanity, while *-jwa* is a playful suffix used in a nickname.

hunks.baseline: [^2]: *Bangzi* is a derogatory Chinese slur for Koreans.
*How does a Chinese person even know about Sibeol-jwa?*
hunks.sol: *How does a Chinese guy even know about Sibeol-jwa?*

hunks.baseline: If I ever went to the United States, maybe some huge Yankee bros would approach me with beer bottles in hand and pretend they knew me.
hunks.sol: If I ever went to the United States, maybe some huge Yankee bros would come up to me with beer bottles in hand and greet me like an old friend.
*I’m fine, thank you. Sibeol.*

hunks.baseline: *I’m fine, thank you. Sibeol. What kind of deranged bastards came up with a nickname like this?*
hunks.sol: What kind of deranged bastards came up with a nickname like this?

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi, who had strung the unconscious flight attendants together like dried fish, and the Skeleton Warlord I had shoved into my inventory both answered.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi, who had strung the unconscious crew members together like dried fish, and the Skeleton Warlord I had shoved into my Inventory both answered.

hunks.baseline: “It is a horrifying sight.”
hunks.sol: “It’s a horrifying sight.”

hunks.baseline: - Vile human, I like this place. It feels familiar and strangely pleasant.
hunks.sol: - Vile human, I like this place. It feels familiar and strangely comforting.

hunks.baseline: There was no need to say more. A named undead monster who could be called death itself found the scene satisfying.
hunks.sol: There was no point saying more. The sight was gruesome enough to please a named undead monster who was practically death itself.

hunks.baseline: “We just got here, and we’re already being thrown into actual combat.”
hunks.sol: “We just got here, and we’re already being thrown into combat.”

hunks.baseline: I clicked my tongue inwardly and spoke.
hunks.sol: I clicked my tongue to myself and spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. That was already my intention.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. I was already planning to.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi was a smart man. Learning the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique had made him incomparably stronger than before, but he was not the sort of person who would ever show off.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was a smart man. Learning the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique had made him incomparably stronger than before, but he was not the sort to show off.

hunks.baseline: I looked the young man up and down as he answered so promptly.
hunks.sol: I looked the young man up and down as he snapped to attention.

hunks.baseline: His face was young, but he was obviously a Hunter. And a powerful one, at that—around A-rank, judging by appearances. Unlike the Hunters around him, who wore identical armor as if they had been stamped out in a factory, he also had a red insignia on his shoulder.
hunks.sol: His face was young, but he was obviously a Hunter. A powerful one, too—around A-rank, judging by appearances. Unlike the Hunters around him, who wore identical armor as if they had been stamped out in a factory, he had a red insignia on his shoulder.

hunks.baseline: “You look like you hold a decent rank, so keep your men in line. Let’s save as many people as we can.”
hunks.sol: “You look like you hold a decent rank, so keep your men together. Let’s save as many people as we can.”

hunks.baseline: As I answered, I thrust out my fist.
hunks.sol: As I spoke, I thrust out my fist.

hunks.baseline: When the wave of searing heat had passed, dozens of monster corpses were all that remained.
hunks.sol: Once the wave of searing heat had swept past, only dozens of monster corpses remained.

hunks.baseline: “K-Kill them! Hold back those monsters!”
hunks.sol: “K-Kill them! Hold back the monsters!”

hunks.baseline: A battle of killing and being killed began. I pulled White Flame from where it was buried deep in the ground and swung it.
hunks.sol: The battle of killing and being killed began anew. I pulled White Flame from where it was embedded deep in the ground and swung it.

hunks.baseline: This was not a situation of half water and half meat—monsters swarmed in every direction.
hunks.sol: Forget waters so crowded they were half water and half fish—monsters were swarming everywhere.

hunks.baseline: A crescent of sword qi extended from the spearhead and grazed a tightly packed mob of monsters.
hunks.sol: A crescent of sword qi extended from the spearhead and swept through a tightly packed mob of monsters.

hunks.baseline: Normally, I would have let such notifications go in one ear and out the other, or simply ignored them.
hunks.sol: Normally, I would have let them go in one ear and out the other, or simply ignored them.

hunks.baseline: “These guys couldn’t possibly be…”
hunks.sol: “Don’t tell me these guys are…”

hunks.baseline: I had already been puzzled because I could not sense any life force from them.
hunks.sol: I had already been wondering why I could not sense any life force from them.

hunks.baseline: A sizeable number of monsters were still alive, but roughly half or more of them were undead. All told, it was an army of close to two thousand monsters.
hunks.sol: A substantial number of the monsters were still alive, but more than half of them were undead. All told, it was an army nearly two thousand strong.

hunks.baseline: “Do you want to disappear like that guy just now? Beautiful, magnificent, and valiant?”
hunks.sol: “Do you want to disappear like that guy just did? Beautifully, magnificently, and valiantly?”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord had briefly forgotten his own situation, then hurriedly added:
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord had briefly forgotten his own situation. He hurriedly added:

hunks.baseline: I thought so, too.
hunks.sol: I thought so too.

hunks.baseline: But there was one thing I still could not be certain about…
hunks.sol: There was only one thing I still was not sure about.

hunks.baseline: “The Lich. Did that bastard come out personally?”
hunks.sol: “The Lich. Is that bastard here in person?”

hunks.baseline: A massive iron club passed dangerously close to my shoulder and smashed into the ground. This was an ordinary ogre, and I could still sense its life force.
hunks.sol: A massive iron club passed dangerously close to my shoulder and smashed into the ground. This was an ordinary ogre, one that still had life force.

hunks.baseline: The ogre was struck in the chest by a Flame Divine Palm, and black-green blood burst from its seven orifices.
hunks.sol: The Flame Divine Palm struck the ogre in the chest, and black-green blood erupted from all seven of its orifices.

hunks.baseline: As I passed its collapsing bulk, I slashed White Flame diagonally downward.
hunks.sol: I passed its collapsing bulk and slashed White Flame diagonally downward.

hunks.baseline: Space itself seemed to split apart, and the bodies of the monsters caught between the two halves were sliced to pieces.
hunks.sol: Space split apart, and the monsters caught within it were sliced to pieces.

hunks.baseline: Leaving behind a Chinese Hunter staring blankly at me, drenched in blood and bodily fluids, I clenched my fist.
hunks.sol: Leaving behind a Chinese Hunter who stared blankly at me, drenched in blood and bodily fluids, I clenched my fist.

hunks.baseline: Along with the foul smell of burning flesh, the few monsters that had somehow survived shrieked in agony.
hunks.sol: The few that somehow survived shrieked in agony as the foul smell of burning flesh filled the air.

hunks.baseline: The attack had enough destructive power to make both monsters and Hunters forget to fight for a moment.
hunks.sol: The attack was powerful enough to make both monsters and Hunters forget to fight for a moment.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord spoke in a stammering voice.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord stammered.

hunks.baseline: “It feels weird being called a monster by a monster. But if it’s not the Lich, then what bastard is causing all this chaos?”
hunks.sol: “It feels weird being called a monster by a monster. But if it isn’t the Lich, then what bastard is causing all this chaos?”

hunks.baseline: - This commander does not know, either. But I can guarantee one thing.
hunks.sol: - This commander does not know either. But I can guarantee one thing.

hunks.baseline: “A guarantee? What?”
hunks.sol: “Guarantee? What?”

hunks.baseline: - That bastard’s control of the undead is a notch below this commander’s. Hahaha! My army! This commander misses you!
hunks.sol: - Whoever is controlling these undead is a notch below this commander. Hahaha! My army! This commander misses you!

hunks.baseline: As I was wondering, a thought suddenly flashed through my mind, and I stopped dead.
hunks.sol: As I considered it, a thought suddenly flashed through my mind, and I stopped dead.

hunks.baseline: “The thing you said about controlling the undead.”
hunks.sol: “That thing you said about controlling the undead.”

hunks.baseline: - Isn’t it obvious? This commander is a Skeleton Warlord. Compared to them, naturally… Huh?
hunks.sol: - Isn’t it obvious? This commander is a Skeleton Warlord. Compared to whoever is controlling them, naturally… Huh?

hunks.baseline: He must have had the same thought I did. After swallowing hard, I casually broached the subject.
hunks.sol: He must have had the same thought I did. I swallowed hard, then casually broached the subject.
